surfaces.title: Java version metadata
surfaces.provenance: Mojang version manifest v2 and per-version metadata JSON
guarantees: release id, type, release time, metadata URL, and SHA-1 are copied from official Mojang metadata
latest bundled Java alias is derived from the checked-in release index
nonGuarantees: does not include snapshot support unless explicitly bundled
does not imply Paper has published a matching server for the same Java version

surfaces.title: Pack format numbers
surfaces.coverage: Java Edition 1.13+ bundled releases where version JSON and jars were extracted
surfaces.provenance: official Mojang version metadata and extracted vanilla jar facts
guarantees: data and resource pack format numbers are version-specific when status is extracted
null values are exposed when the fact is unavailable
nonGuarantees: does not explain behavioral migration steps by itself
does not make unsupported versions compatible

surfaces.title: Generated server reports
surfaces.provenance: official Mojang server jar data generator reports
guarantees: summaries are derived from generated vanilla server reports for the target version
command report availability is represented explicitly
nonGuarantees: does not include copied Minecraft Wiki prose
does not replace in-game testing for command side effects

surfaces.title: Command syntax paths
surfaces.provenance: command trees extracted from official server reports
guarantees: search results are executable command syntax paths observed in generated command trees
version comparisons report added and removed syntax paths
nonGuarantees: does not prove command semantics, permissions, runtime selectors, or side effects
does not infer undocumented aliases

surfaces.title: Vanilla asset and data inventories
surfaces.provenance: official Mojang client and server jars
guarantees: vanilla resource and datapack entry counts, namespaces, top-level folders, and sample paths are extracted from jars
version comparisons report top-level inventory changes
nonGuarantees: does not include modded, server-specific, or third-party pack files
samples are representative, not complete lists

surfaces.title: Vanilla asset and data paths
surfaces.provenance: official Mojang client and server jars
guarantees: path search returns exact vanilla asset/data paths for the selected version and domain
version comparisons report added and removed paths
nonGuarantees: does not validate custom pack JSON content
does not include generated files outside the official jars

surfaces.title: Observed datapack JSON field shapes
surfaces.coverage: downloadable or bundled versions listed in the support matrix
surfaces.provenance: vanilla datapack JSON files extracted from official Mojang server jars
guarantees: field paths, value kind counts, and sample file paths are observed from vanilla files for the exact version
comparison reports added and removed observed field paths
nonGuarantees: not a normative schema
does not prove all valid custom datapack fields
does not prove field semantics beyond observed JSON shape

surfaces.title: Observed resource pack model shapes
surfaces.provenance: vanilla resource pack model and item definition JSON extracted from official Mojang client jars
guarantees: model and item definition path summaries are observed from vanilla files for the exact version
search can locate paths and shape summaries by kind, prefix, or text
nonGuarantees: not a normative schema
does not prove all valid custom model or item definition fields
does not include textures or binary asset validation

surfaces.title: Paper build support metadata
surfaces.coverage: Paper versions listed in checked-in PaperMC project metadata
surfaces.provenance: PaperMC project API and Paper documentation links
guarantees: latest supported Paper Minecraft version and build count are recorded from PaperMC data
gap between latest Java and latest Paper is explicit
nonGuarantees: does not prove a future Paper build exists before PaperMC publishes it
does not include third-party forks

surfaces.title: Paper Javadocs package index
surfaces.coverage: Paper versions where package tables or indexes are bundled
guarantees: package names and package URLs are extracted from Paper Javadocs for the target version
comparison reports added and removed package names
nonGuarantees: does not include method-level API details
does not copy Javadocs prose or prove method behavior

surfaces.title: Paper Javadocs type and member surface
surfaces.coverage: downloadable or bundled versions listed in the support matrix
guarantees: type names, member labels, package names, and URLs are extracted from Javadocs search indexes
comparison reports added and removed observed type/member labels
nonGuarantees: does not copy Javadocs prose
does not prove method behavior, overload semantics, nullability, or thread safety
does not replace Paper documentation for Folia-sensitive behavior

surfaces.title: Paper and Bukkit event discovery
surfaces.coverage: versions and sources supported by the configured spigot-event-list API
surfaces.provenance: sya-ri/spigot-event-list API contract and live API responses
guarantees: query URL construction follows the checked-in event search contract
live search can find candidate events by behavior text, partial names, or localized text when network access is available
nonGuarantees: network access may be unavailable
search results are discovery candidates and still need Paper/Bukkit API verification
does not prove event firing order or cancellation semantics
